facts.fact: The Sport, Arts and Culture minister's written reply says there is no standalone law on AI-generated likeness misuse, but common law rights, POPIA (covering images and voice recordings) and defamation law already give protection against deepfakes.

ZAF.note: Nothing on a government body using an AI system.
The reply says only that no standalone law covers AI likeness misuse; no AI law or draft is stated, and the copyright bills are not AI-specific.
Nothing on an AI tool in a public sector system.
Nothing on AI built or hosted in South Africa.

facts.fact: The minister's written reply cites the Protection of Personal Information Act as regulating processing of personal information, including biometric data.

ZAF.note: Nothing on the national ID system.
No local research institution is named.
